label: EXACT_MEREOLOGICAL_REMAINDER_1: Complementation B requires, for x,y with y not part of x, a z whose…
definition: Complementation B requires, for x,y with y not part of x, a z whose parts are exactly the parts of y disjoint from x. It includes every such disjoint part, rather than merely one separating part. The conditional does not require an empty remainder when y is part of x.
note: Analyst framework for #1054, attribution deferred. Reuses the existing fixed partial-order domain and common-part Overlap without modal or actual-existence guards. Mathematical witnesses do not establish real-world parthood applicability. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
